0022600007.text: The Denver Nuggets open their 2026-27 season on the road against the Oklahoma City Thunder, who are 1-0, have won their only game, and sit 1st in the Northwest and 2nd in the West. The teams have not met yet this season, and in 2025-26 the Nuggets lost the series 1-3, though Denver won their last meeting 127-107 in Denver on April 10, 2026. Julian Strawther is out with a knee sprain and Spencer Jones is day-to-day with a hamstring injury and a game-time decision for the Nuggets, while the Thunder will be without Nikola Topic (back surgery), Otega Oweh (Achilles surgery), and Thomas Sorber (knee surgery).
